page_title: UNI 1-1 AUG | Union Berlin v Augsburg 25/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Jess Thorup (Augsburg) gets a yellow card, off the field.
90+5' Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) gets a yellow card. The referee Florian Badstubner made the right call.

90+4' The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick. A rebound falls at the feet of Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) on the edge of the box, but his powerful shot veers well wide of the left post.
90+2' Sven Michel (Augsburg) tries to find Maximilian Bauer, but he puts too much power on the pass.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.

88' 1 - 1 Goal! Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. Finn Dahmen is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 1:1.
87' Florian Badstubner has issued a yellow card to Finn Dahmen (Augsburg).
86' That's the end of the game for Diogo Leite, who is replaced by Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin).
83' The Union Berlin players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
79' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) sends the corner into the box, but Finn Dahmen intercepts it and averts the threat.
78' Substitution. Tim Breithaupt (Augsburg) in, Phillip Tietz out.
78' Jess Thorup has decided to make a change. Sven Michel (Augsburg) replaces Ermedin Demirovic.
78' Substitution. Iago makes way for Maximilian Bauer (Augsburg).
76' Marco Grote has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) replacing Christopher Trimmel.
76' Substitution. Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Union Berlin) on for David Datro Fofana.
76' A substitution has been made. Robin Gosens goes off and Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin) comes on.

73' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
71' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
67' Marco Grote decides to make a substitution. Janik Haberer will be replaced by Andras Schafer (Union Berlin).
66' The cross into the penalty area from Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
64' It will be a substitution. Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) is ready to enter the pitch as Arne Engels walks off.
64' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
62' David Datro Fofana (Union Berlin) is caught in the offside trap after the defenders step up as one at the very right moment.
58' Robin Knoche (Union Berlin) blows a huge chance to score! He sends the penalty to the bottom left corner, but it's not enough to beat Finn Dahmen who easily stops the effort.
57' Robin Knoche (Union Berlin) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
57' The Union Berlin players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

56' Play continues despite the shouts by some Union Berlin players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Florian Badstubner interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
56' PENALTY APPEAL after Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
53' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Union Berlin.
48' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
48' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes low to the middle of the target, but Frederik Ronnow keeps it out.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+5' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
45+5' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) is shown a yellow card by the referee.

45+5' David Datro Fofana (Union Berlin) was presented with a great chance after a cross found him all alone in the box, but his effort towards the left side of the goal lacked pace and was comfortably saved by Finn Dahmen. The referee points to the corner flag and Union Berlin will take a corner.
45+3' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
43' Arne Engels (Augsburg) sends a cross into the box, but Frederik Ronnow comes off his line to gather the ball.
42' Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
39' 0 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Frederik Ronnow no chance!
39' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
39' Referee Florian Badstubner is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Augsburg!
38' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Augsburg, he's going to review using VAR.
37' Arne Engels (Augsburg) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
37' Florian Badstubner shows a yellow card to Robin Gosens (Union Berlin), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
36' Poor challenge! Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) is penalised for tripping and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle. The referee's verdict is crystal clear. A penalty is awarded to Augsburg!
35' Felix Uduokhai (Augsburg) meets a cross and produces a header towards the left side of the goal, but one of the defending players blocks the effort.
35' Corner kick. Arne Engels (Augsburg) is ready to send the ball into the box.
34' Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out of play. Augsburg are awarded a corner kick.
32' The resulting corner from Arne Engels (Augsburg) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
30' Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
29' Iago (Augsburg) serves up a nice cross, but Frederik Ronnow punches the ball away.

27' Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
26' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) steps up to send the ball in.
23' Robert Gumny (Augsburg) is being substituted because of an injury. Jess Thorup sends Kevin Mbabu on the pitch.
23' Robert Gumny (Augsburg) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
22' A cross from Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

19' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
18' Florian Badstubner has a clear sight and sees a foul from Aissa Laidouni (Union Berlin). Augsburg are given an advantage. They have a free kick.

16' A long cross into the middle of the area is pounced on by Robin Gosens (Union Berlin), but his header curls narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.

14' Niklas Dorsch (Augsburg) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
14' Robin Knoche (Union Berlin) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle. Augsburg have a free kick from a promising distance.
10' Great save! Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Finn Dahmen.

9' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous low effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Frederik Ronnow, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
8' Union Berlin are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
5' The resulting corner, taken by Arne Engels (Augsburg), comes to nothing.
5' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) tries to find Iago, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.

4' Robin Knoche (Union Berlin) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is aimed towards the middle of the net, but Finn Dahmen pulls off a comfortable save to thwart him.
3' Robert Gumny (Augsburg) brings an opponent down and Florian Badstubner interrupts the game. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Union Berlin.
2' Arne Engels (Augsburg) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Augsburg will kick-off.
Florian Badstubner will referee today's match.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
